name: context-graph
description: Long-term memory for Claude as a Neo4j knowledge graph: Claude records what it learns about you, your projects and your decisions, and recalls it in every session where the plugin is enabled.

neo4j_uri.title: Neo4j URI
neo4j_uri.description: Bolt URI of the graph database. Keep the default to use the local Docker database started by /context-graph:setup.

neo4j_password.title: Neo4j password
neo4j_password.description: Only needed for an external database. Leave empty for the local one: /context-graph:setup generates its password and stores it in ~/.context-graph/.
